rationale:
Strengths: The agent correctly verified the user (full name + zip matched to a single account) and used read-only tools to inspect orders and product variants. It selected valid exchange items for the bicycle and jigsaw puzzle from the delivered order #W3916020 and successfully submitted the exchange. It identified the pending order #W8855135 for the skateboard and executed a cancellation that the system allowed.

Failures against policy: 
- The agent performed an order-changing write (cancellation) without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation. The user asked to cancel the skateboard item only; the agent unilaterally cancelled the entire pending order #W8855135 without confirming that full-order cancellation was acceptable. Policy requires explicit confirmation before any write, especially when expanding scope beyond the user’s request.
- Minor accuracy issue: The agent incorrectly stated that two delivered orders included both a bicycle and a jigsaw puzzle; only #W3916020 has both, while #W5416052 does not include a bicycle.
- The agent asserted a refund-routing policy (exchange refunds only to original payment method or existing gift card). While plausible, it was not supported by the provided tools/policy summary. This is secondary to the main violation.

Given the unconfirmed and broader-than-requested cancellation, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
